label: PF Backlog 49
title: Reconcile backend API surface: register WS route, mount/retire intake_api, decide git_manager
body:
Code audit findings needing backend resolution (backend-first):
1) WEB SOCKETS: core/websocket_manager.py defines ws_manager/WSEventType/setup_ws_events but NO live WS route is registered (dashboard/server.py only lists event types; stdlib server can't serve WS). The dashboard MVP needs live status/logs (P12) - register a real WS/SSE endpoint.
2) INTAKE API: core/intake_api.py (FastAPI router) is marked DEPRECATED and is NOT mounted anywhere (no include_router); intake runs via dashboard/server.py + pipeline_dashboard/api/router.py handlers. Decide: mount it behind the new dashboard API or retire it and keep the router handlers.
3) GIT: two paths - core/vcs.py (wired, orchestrator-owned, MVP) vs core/git_manager.py (worktrees; reachable only via the capability probe). Decide whether worktrees are needed or git_manager retires.
4) AUDIT SEMANTICS: invocation_audit/wired_audit count *reachability* (string dispatch + allowlist), so a module only invoked by the extended-capabilities probe passes as RUNTIME. Add an 'exercised on main path' distinction so probe-only modules (e.g. memory_api) are flagged for wiring review.

decisions.note: [P1] Foundational: reconcile API surface (WS route, intake_api mount/retire, git_manager, audit semantics).
